aaa_enabled.summary: Configure external AAA authentication servers (RADIUS or TACACS+) for centralized management authentication.
cli: add aaa radius-servers priority 1 host <RADIUS-IP> secret <SHARED-SECRET> timeout 5
add aaa radius-servers priority 2 host <BACKUP-RADIUS-IP> secret <SHARED-SECRET> timeout 5
aaa_enabled.notes: Gaia supports RADIUS and TACACS+ for centralized authentication. Configure at least two servers for redundancy. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Authentication Servers.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Gaia OS provides SSH and HTTPS access only; telnet is not available. No remediation needed.
cli: # Gaia does not expose a telnet service; SSH and HTTPS only.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Gaia does not expose a telnet service. SSH is always available for CLI management and HTTPS for the Gaia Portal.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Set the CLI inactivity timeout to 10 minutes or less.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: The inactivity-timeout value is in minutes (range 1-720, default 10). Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Session.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Configure a strong password hash type and enforce password complexity.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: SHA512 is the strongest hash option. Complexity 4 requires characters from all four categories (upper, lower, digit, special). Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Password Policy.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default SNMP community strings and restrict to SNMPv3.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: SNMPv3 with authentication and encryption is recommended. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - SNMP.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Remove all read-write SNMP community strings; use SNMPv3 for write access.
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Read-write SNMP communities allow remote configuration changes. Use SNMPv3 with auth+priv instead. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - SNMP.

http_server_disabled.summary: Gaia does not serve HTTP management traffic. No remediation needed.
cli: # Gaia Portal is HTTPS-only by default; no action required.
http_server_disabled.notes: The Gaia Portal is HTTPS-only by default.

ssh_version_2.summary: Gaia OS supports SSHv2 only by default. No remediation needed.
cli: # Gaia OS enforces SSHv2 natively; no action required.
ssh_version_2.notes: SSHv1 is not supported on Gaia OS.

management_acl.summary: Configure external AAA servers to restrict management authentication.
cli: add aaa radius-servers priority 1 host <RADIUS-IP> secret <SHARED-SECRET> timeout 5
management_acl.notes: On Gaia, management access restriction is achieved through external AAA servers and firewall policy. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Authentication Servers.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure remote syslog servers and enable audit logging.
logging_enabled.notes: Configure at least one remote syslog server. Enable CP logs and management audit logs for complete visibility. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - System Logging.

ntp_configured.summary: Configure primary and secondary NTP servers for time synchronization.
ntp_configured.notes: At least two NTP servers should be configured for redundancy. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Time and Date.

login_banner.summary: Configure a login banner with an authorized-use notice.
cli: set message banner on msgvalue "Authorized access only. All activity is monitored and logged."
login_banner.notes: A legal notice banner is required before login. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Messages.

password_min_length.summary: Set minimum password length to at least 8 characters.
password_min_length.notes: Range is 6-128 characters. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Password Policy.

password_expiration.summary: Set password expiration to 90 days or less.
password_expiration.notes: Range is 1-1827 days or 'never'. Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Password Policy.

lockout_configured.summary: Enable account lockout after failed login attempts.
lockout_configured.notes: The allow-after value is in seconds (range 60-604800). Ref: R81 Gaia Admin Guide - Password Policy.
